training.dataset: Reviewed hospital annotations, sperm264 v6 labels (train+val)

datasetSource: Initial weights from the SVIA-trained model: https://github.com/Demozsj/Detection-Sperm . Fine-tuned on this tool's own reviewed hospital annotations.
datasetUseNotice: Weights contain no images, videos or annotation files. Fine-tuning used hospital annotations produced with this tool; upstream SVIA terms still apply to the initial weights. No clinical approval is granted.

inference.input: whole frame, grayscale copied to 3 channels, long side resized to 1024 with INTER_AREA
